readers-shared source dependency
  Built from the sibling readers-shared workspace, selected through its public .props entry.
  Source: https://github.com/ZhFuGui/readers-shared
  Validated local source commit: 47655f96288f0d67d8bdcad2d30bdd69c5f82618 (not yet pushed at validation).
  TCP transport is built through readers-shared-tcp.props alongside the selected memory backend.
  Hyper-mem ABI source commit: 16ec538165785e5f755e7dfc7372485edb5e9ebb.
  See readers-shared/third_party/NOTICE.txt, hypermem/UPSTREAM.json and supplied license texts.
  No hypervisor installation, code-hook or memory-hiding functionality is included here.
  Earlier hyper-reV and Hyper_rw license texts are retained for historical source attribution.
